description: WHAT: Multi-match Einsatzgebiete by q, name, or slug (substring, umlauts ok). RETURNS all matching point cards. Same match rules as find_by_gebiet — prefer this name when the agent thinks in 'area' wording. USE for fuzzy place names. DOES NOT require an exact slug. Prefer find_by_plz for postcode-only queries. NEXT: get_service_area, get_embed_map.

name.description: German place name substring (case-insensitive, umlauts ok), e.g. Grünbühl, Pattonville. Used when slug/plz omitted.

slug.description: URL slug of one of the 52 Einsatzgebiete, e.g. pattonville, bietigheim-bissingen, walheim, gruenbuehl. Matches https://maps.ikeytz.com/{slug}. Lookup order when combined with plz/name: slug first.

name: find_by_area
title: Find By Area
